scenarios.name: Duplicate the active model state in an empty part

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
the user creates and activates a named non-primary model state in this session
the Model State branch is expanded
the user opens the Model State branch context menu
the user opens the New Model State submenu
the duplicate action identifies the active state by name
the user chooses to duplicate the active state
a new model-state row appears with its generated name selected for editing
the source model state remains marked active
the user enters a distinct name and presses Enter
the source and renamed duplicate both remain in the tree
the source model state remains marked active
the Model State branch, browser root and document tab identify the duplicate
